intro: Welcome! If you're invited you are certainly special to us, and we would be honored to share this special day with you! Please join us for fun, festivities, and good food in beautiful Estes Park, Colorado. We look forward to celebrating together!
details: We're still setting up the RSVPs, but for now you can find some general information on this website including time, date, location, and general timeline for those of you who want to join us for other fun activities before and after the wedding! Check out the sections below for Schedule, Travel, and FAQs for additional info. Feel free to contact Gen or Lilith with any questions, alternatively you may also contact Deb or George should be able to help answer most as well.
